name: instant-cognition
description: A hotkey-summoned AI browser: run local models with llama.cpp or MLX, drive the page with an agent, and search the web without leaving the keyboard.
author: Sellitus

scripts.start: node scripts/build-css.js && node scripts/build-renderer.js && node scripts/fetch-moonshine-model.js && electron .
scripts.package-mac-arm: node scripts/build-css.js && node scripts/build-renderer.js && LLAMA_PLATFORM=darwin LLAMA_ARCH=arm64 node scripts/fetch-llama-server.js && MLX_PLATFORM=darwin MLX_ARCH=arm64 node scripts/fetch-mlx-runtime.js && OMLX_PLATFORM=darwin OMLX_ARCH=arm64 node scripts/fetch-omlx-runtime.js && node scripts/fetch-moonshine-model.js && electron-packager . InstantCognition --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --overwrite --icon=assets/icon.icns --out=builds/mac-arm --asar=false
